appearance.identity: The complete mapped Yerevan gorge crossing: yellow steel box girders, four paired tall concrete pier stations, shallow approach viaducts, a broad six-lane road, two sidewalks, open white rails and inward-reaching lamps.
appearance.sourceMaster: Detailed source with dense stiffeners and rail posts is separate from all four complete browser levels.
appearance.exclusions: Hidden structure, temporary signs/banners, vehicles, exact present traffic and trolley operation, adjoining retaining walls and utility lines crossing the gorge are excluded.
